feeds.title: La SCENA » Classical Music
feeds.description: Read articles on classical music brought to you by La Scena Musicale. La Scena Musicale is one of the world's most respected classical music, opera and jazz magazine.

feeds.title: SAISONS MUSIQUE Blog
feeds.description: SAISONS MUSIQUE - Montreal-based label that brings together the creative talents of Canadian artist Kora and his closest collaborators. The imprint strives to shine a light on both the engaging and the obscure, offering a variety of tastes from across the electronic spectrum where organic elements and modern means collide.

feeds.title: EKM.CO
feeds.description: EKM.CO has been covering the best electronic music from underground to the mainstream since 2009. Spotify Playlists, Free Music Downloads, MP3s, DJ Mixes & more.

feeds.title: Musiprof Blog
feeds.description: Musiprof is a service that connects music teachers and students in Montreal. Our mission is to improve the experience of music education by offering teachers and students the ideal teaching experience.

feeds.title: Bolting Bits
feeds.description: Bolting Bits is a Montreal-based online musical magazine co-founded by Numea Daze, born from the desire to promote music in all of its forms, extending the experience by organizing monthly events in various Montreal venues. Exploring many musical genres, the webzine invites local and international artists to share their vision of music and innovation.

feeds.title: Cult MTL » Music
feeds.description: Explore our blog for good music, and news. CULT MTL is a media website that publishes news and articles about art & life, film & tv, music, food & drink, events, and more.

feeds.title: For the Record Blog
feeds.description: Hello there, I'm Sun and welcome to For the Record! This Montreal-based publication is simply comprised of music reviews, interviews, and all the other news from my favorite local and touring artists.

feeds.title: Montreal Rocks
feeds.description: Montreal Rocks brings you reviews and photos from gigs throughout Montreal, the latest news, album reviews, interviews, and a regularly updated gig guide. Search for a band or venue for in-depth reviews and some great band photography.

feeds.title: Le Canal Auditif
feeds.description: Le Canal Auditif is a Quebec blog dedicated to independent music featuring experienced and enthusiastic collaborators.

feeds.title: Fly Away Recording + Media Studio Blog
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Jake! I have been passionately invested in the music world for over 20 years now! You are looking for useful information about how to create your own music? Check out my blog to get all my professional sound engineer advice!

feeds.title: Said the Gramophone
feeds.description: Said the Gramophone launched in March 2003 and added songs in November of that year. It was one of the world's first mp3blogs. This is a daily sampler of really good songs. All tracks are posted out of love.

feeds.title: Montreal Gazette » Music
feeds.description: Find reviews on the newest albums from top artists in country music, rap music, hip hop, rock, EDM, indie and more. The Montreal Gazette, founded in 1778, has reported on events dating back to the French Revolution. It publishes news, sports, opinion, business, art, life, and more.

feeds.title: Stingray
feeds.description: Stingray is proud to provide a wide range of music streaming services for all tastes. Our music services are offered on a variety of platforms to connect with customers anywhere, anytime. Our difference lies in our global reach combined with an ability to adapt to local tastes and trends in response to our partners' unique requirements.
